honest_limits_what_anima_actually_gains_: QA1-QA3 (CLM Lagrangian quantum embedding): AT 4-QUBIT TOY SCALE THERE IS NO QUANTUM ADVANTAGE. Classical exact-diagonalization solves 16×16 matrices in microseconds. The value of these axes is METHODOLOGICAL (proves the embedding works), not COMPUTATIONAL.

QA4 (QBM): D-Wave annealer chip topology forces minor-embedding overhead 5-10× — for anima's 6-axis paradigm-v11 distribution this means 30-60 physical qubits, well within Advantage 4.1 (5000+ qubits) but the 'quantum' advantage is not yet demonstrated to beat classical RBM on small distributions in published literature (Dixit et al. 2021 showed parity, not advantage).
QA5 (QGNN): anima's N-substrate graph (31 nodes) is FAR below the regime where QGNN demonstrates advantage (>1000 nodes per Tang/Yan 2024). Strictly methodology proof-of-concept.

QA6 (QRNG): The MOST HONEST axis. anima's chacha20 PRNG passes NIST SP 800-22 for current usage. Quantum source provides AUDIT TRAIL not statistical advantage. PASS verdict (as predicted) confirms classical adequacy — this is honest-null science.

Plan A/B (extension): TRUE WITNESS UPGRADE. Adds statistical power to a real measurement. Cost $200 buys n=2 → n=5 + 3-vendor cross-check. This is the only axis where Braket QPU spend buys irreducible scientific information.
Phase 2 (φ★ upgrade): Uses ALREADY-PAID-FOR measurements — 100% scientific gain at $0 marginal QPU cost. Cleanest closure of #120 honest_C3 #1.

Phase 2 φ★ is a DEFINITION upgrade, not a quantum-advantage claim.
